Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1614087. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno as inner join. Filter activities where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
